address: 1249 E Main St, Lehi, UT 84043, United States

reviewText:
This place is fun. It’s well decorated, clean, the staff is friendly, the pricing is reasonable and the food is delicious!

I loved how soft the cookies and brownies were, and that they can heat them up for you ice cream sandwich.

My husband and I tried combo sandwiches, meaning half cookie half brownie. I tried a cookies and cream cookie and it was good.
My husband particularly liked his dark chocolate ice cream. He said it was super creamy.

I look forward to coming back.
